title: Targets Summary
description: Audit volume, users, clients, and failures by target database.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' | eval 'Failure Flag' = if('Operation Status' = 'FAILURE', 1, 0) | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Database User') as Users, distinctcount('Client IP') as Clients, sum('Failure Flag') as Failures by 'Data Safe Target Name' | sort -Events
